protocol.sourceSplit: 12 calibration and 12 held-out source-post groups; donor posts stay in same split.
protocol.negativeDefinition: No additional local editing applied by this benchmark; source authenticity is unknown.
protocol.referenceAssisted: Gallery includes comparable baseline images as an explicit inference input; not a blind single-image forgery task.
protocol.generated: Six crops from one independently generated contact sheet; all held-out, correlated, one generator family.
protocol.maskDefinition: Applied alpha >0.05; actual controlled editing region, not claimed human annotation.
protocol.scope: Four lipstick shades; controlled operations do not measure prevalence or real-world deception accuracy.
